text: Setting clear goals is essential for any project’s success. A useful method is to create SMART goals, which means they are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. For example, instead of saying “improve the website,” you might say “increase page speed by 20% within three months.” Breaking a large project into smaller milestones helps you track progress and stay motivated. Each milestone should have clear deliverables, such as a completed report or a working prototype. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. Make sure everyone involved—like clients, team members, and managers—agrees on the objectives from the start. This prevents confusion later and keeps the whole team focused on the same result.
